verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an official Python library (browser-use, github) plus a cloud SDK (client.runs.create, sessions, structured output, events) and a documented OpenAPI 3.1 spec with 21 paths that can generate clients — strong first-party SDK/API surface for AI-native builders. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK coverage (e.g. JS/TS client) and independent hands-on developer reviews of the SDK itself beyond general library popularity.
